description: Exact implementation surfaces the implementation-path manifest gate may be built on. Written before the Engineer commit this time, which is the whole point of the control: the equivalent manifest for R7-F012 was checked after the fact and so disclosed an unnamed path instead of preventing it.

rationale.scripts/check-implementation-path-manife: The gate itself: for every substantive Engineer commit after the declared boundary, every substantive implementation path in its diff must be named in an implementation-path manifest committed by a prior Inspector commit.
rationale.package.json: Wires the gate into the existing ci:governance chain. The literal sixteen-command roster is unchanged, so the gate is added without altering any authoritative argv.

forbidden: any change to the sixteen literal convergence commands
any relaxation of an existing schema floor
any widening of an existing allowlist
